facebook.caption: Tourists walk straight past this. Locals shop here every morning. The day market on 49 Đường Ngô Quyền is where Phu Quoc actually buys its food. Fresh produce, local snacks, everyday prices. No menus in English. No tourist markup. Just real market life two streets from the main drag. Go before 9am. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
